channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
item.description: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

item.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
item.description: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

item.description: NDMA head confirms the formation of two new lakes and moraines, but says no information is available on water volume; monitoring limitations mean that early warning systems may not be able to prevent another such disaster Fresh glacial lakes form at source of Nepal’s ice-rock avalanche.

item.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
item.description: Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hoursAustrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty.

item.title: For survivors of serious illness, a second battle begins at the workplace after treatment ends
item.description: Accommodating the needs of a worker returning to the office after a serious illness can create operational challenges, but open communication and adaptable work arrangements can allow the staff member to recover while continuing to contribute, survivors and managers say. For survivors of serious illness, a second battle begins at the workplace after treatment ends.

item.title: A strict diet helped manage my chronic hives – and changed my relationship with food
item.description: After a severe flare-up left her desperate for relief, CNA TODAY's Amanda Yeap went on a low-histamine diet, cutting out many of the foods she once enjoyed. But the months of restrictive eating took a toll on her in ways she did not expect. A strict diet helped manage my chronic hives – and changed my relationship with food.

item.title: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo spreads to two new health zones with total of 60 areas now affected
item.description: The two new zones affected are Biena and Manguredjipa in Congo's North Kivu Province, where the case fatality rate is much higher than the overall rate of 48%, due in part to delayed response efforts, according to Congo's Ministry of Health data Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo spreads to two new health zones with total of 60 areas now affected.

item.title: Pakistan’s new mediation push revives hopes for US-Iran climbdown
item.description: Pakistan’s latest diplomatic push on the Iran-US conflict has revived an old question about Islamabad’s regional role: is it merely carrying messages between Washington and Tehran, or has it developed enough political access and credibility to act as an independent mediator? Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir’s August 24 visit to Tehran points toward the latter.

item.title: Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages
item.description: An "all-Russian" MC-21 passenger jet made its first test flight in early August, marking a step closer to full production, due to begin in 2027. But years of geopolitical turbulence have pushed the project far off-course, aviation insiders say. Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages.

item.title: India, Canada reiterate commitment to complete trade deal by end of 2026
item.description: A joint statement, issued by the Finance Ministers of both countries following the conclusion of the inaugural India-Canada Finance Ministers’ Economic and Financial Dialogue in Toronto, said that India had expressed its readiness to begin negotiations on a Bilateral Investment Treaty “at the earliest” India, Canada reiterate commitment to complete trade deal by end of 2026.

item.title: Trump Dismisses Fears Of Russian Strike On NATO After CIA Chief Visits Moscow
item.description: US President Donald Trump told reporters that he does not believe Moscow will attack a NATO nation amid rising concerns that Russian President Vladimir Putin will strike a Baltic country or other member state to test the Western alliance’s resolve. Trump Dismisses Fears of Russian Strike On NATO After CIA Chief Visits Moscow.

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village
item.description: After a Ukrainian drone operator spotted an SOS sign outside a destroyed home in the Donetsk region, a three-day rescue mission was launched to save a couple who were the last remaining residents of their frontline village. Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village.

item.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
item.description: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

item.description: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges.
